# Chunk

- **CURIE:** [`gmeow:Chunk`](gmeow-Chunk.md)
- **IRI:** <https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/Chunk>
- **Category:** class
- **Defined by:** [`gmeow:slices/ai`](../../slices/ai.md)

A contiguous segment of a source information object, produced by a chunking step for retrieval — the unit a retrieval returns, a model reads, and an evidence span pins into. Located in its source by [`gmeow:chunkOf`](../properties/gmeow-chunkOf.md) + gmeow:spanStart/gmeow:spanEnd and content-addressed via the EXISTING [`gmeow:contentDigest`](../properties/gmeow-contentDigest.md) (sources slice), so 'which exact bytes did the model see?' is answerable after the fact.

## Structure

**Subclass of:** [`gmeow:InformationObject`](gmeow-InformationObject.md)

## Practical Pattern

Use [`gmeow:Chunk`](gmeow-Chunk.md) as a specialized kind of [`gmeow:InformationObject`](gmeow-InformationObject.md). Add statement metadata or a standpoint when the assertion needs provenance, confidence, or vantage.
